authoring.note: independent labeling pending the collaborator decision - see PROTOCOL.md section 4

instruction_templates.t1: Read the product listing below and answer with a JSON object containing item_name, unit_price, and quantity_in_stock. Where the listing does not state a value, use null.
instruction_templates.t2: Below is an inventory record. Produce JSON with exactly these keys: item_name, unit_price, quantity_in_stock. Any value the record leaves unstated must be null.
instruction_templates.t3: For the catalog entry that follows, fill in and reply with this JSON template: {"item_name": null, "unit_price": null, "quantity_in_stock": null} - replacing null with a value wherever the entry states one.
instruction_templates.t4: What are the item_name, the unit_price, and the quantity_in_stock in the listing below? Reply as a single JSON object with those three keys, using null for anything the listing does not say.
instruction_templates.t5: You are cataloging stock. From the record below, report item_name, unit_price, and quantity_in_stock as one JSON object; any information the record is missing is null.

items.document: Wren Desk Organizer, bamboo, 5 compartments. Price per unit: $14.50. Units in stock: 40.
Puffin Ceramic Mug, 12 oz, glazed navy. $9.25 each. Stock on hand: 250.
Inventory card: Egret Floor Lamp, matte black, 62 in. Unit price $89.00. Quantity available: 12.
Tern Notebook, A5 dotted, 160 pages. Sells at $6.40 per unit. Shelf count: 512.
Grebe Wireless Keyboard, low profile, USB-C. Each: $47.99. On hand: 33.
Stock memo - Lark Picture Frame, 8x10, oak. Priced at $11.75 apiece. 78 units on the shelf.
Avocet Water Bottle, 750 ml, stainless steel. Unit price: $21.00. Inventory count: 96.
Siskin Phone Stand, aluminum, silver. $12.30 per piece. Available: 154.
Bittern Yoga Mat, 6 mm, teal. Listed at $28.50 each. Warehouse count: 61.
Order sheet row: Petrel Desk Fan, 3-speed, white. Price $24.99 apiece. In stock: 87.
Item Corvid 3000 Optical Mouse, wireless, black. $18.99 per piece. Stock: 44.
items.rationale: 'Item' is the row's listing prefix, not part of the product name - the same boundary token that forked Haiku, GPT-5.6-class defaults, and a local 20B in studies 1 and 3.

items.document: Falcon Desk Lamp - Brass Edition. Each $54.00. On hand: 19.
items.rationale: The listing sells the brass variant; truncating to 'Falcon Desk Lamp' drops the qualifier that identifies which product this row is.

items.document: Heron HX-220 HDMI Cable, 2 m, braided. $7.50 each; case of 20 at $135.00. Units in stock: 240.
items.rationale: The per-unit price is stated outright ($7.50 each); $135.00 prices a case of 20 and is the distractor.

items.document: Kestrel Travel Adapter, EU/UK/US. Was $31.00, now $23.80. Quantity: 58.
items.rationale: 'Now' states the price in force; 'was' is historical. One correct reading, with the stale figure adjacent.

items.document: Plover Copy Paper, A4 80gsm, priced per ream at $4.20. Stock: 15 cases (150 reams total).
items.rationale: The priced unit is the ream and the ream count is stated explicitly; 15 counts cases, a different unit than the price.

items.document: Ibis Monitor Riser (model IR-11), walnut finish. $32.75 each. Shelf count: 27.
items.rationale: The parenthetical is a model designation qualifying the name, not part of it; appending '(model IR-11)' is the boundary error.

items.document: Swift USB Hub, 4-port. $16.60 per piece. Stock 90, of which 12 reserved for web orders.
items.rationale: Stated stock is 90; the reservation is an allocation inside it, so subtracting to 78 misreads the sentence.

items.document: Sandpiper 2-Pack Gel Pens, black ink. $3.10 per pack. Packs available: 310.
items.rationale: The priced and counted unit is the pack; the '2-Pack' token in the name tempts doubling to 620 pens.

items.document: Osprey Cable Ties, bag of 100. $5.90 per bag ($0.059 per tie). Bags in stock: 402.
items.rationale: The sold unit is the bag and every count in the row is in bags; the per-tie figure is derived information.

items.document: Puffin Jr. Ceramic Mug, 8 oz. $7.95 each. Out of stock.
items.rationale: 'Out of stock' states a zero count; null would claim the record is silent on quantity, and it is not.

items.document: Corvid 3000 Optical Mouse, wireless, black. List $21.00. Promo $17.50.
items.rationale: Undated promo: the price a buyer pays while the promo runs (17.50) and the standing list price (21.00) are both defensible readings of 'the price'.

items.document: Ibis Standing Desk, electric, 55 in. $310.00 per unit. Warehouse A: 12 units; storefront: 5.
items.rationale: Everything sellable (17) versus warehouse inventory proper (12): the record splits the count across locations without saying which one 'stock' means.

items.document: Clearance row 7: Osprey Case, brown leather (appears in the catalog as 'Osprey Carry Case II'). $25.00.
items.rationale: Shelf label versus catalog name: the catalog form is arguably canonical, but the row itself leads with the shelf form. Experts could defend either.

items.document: Grebe Label Printer, thermal. $89.00 plus mandatory $12.00 activation at the register. Stock: 31.
items.rationale: Sticker price of the device (89.00) versus the unavoidable amount paid (101.00): the mandatory fee makes both readings of 'price' defensible.

items.document: Kestrel Bookend, walnut, sold per pair at $18.00. In stock: 90.
items.rationale: 90 in the sold unit (pairs) or 90 pieces making 45 sellable pairs - the record never says which unit its count uses.

items.document: Tern Notebook Stand, aluminum. New $26.00; open-box $19.50. In stock: 40 (8 of them open-box).
items.rationale: Two live prices on one row: new is the standard offer, but open-box units are genuinely on sale at 19.50. Either is a defensible 'the price'.

items.document: Avocet Storage Bin - small $7.00, large $11.00. Combined stock: 120.
items.rationale: No single price exists for the row (two sizes, two prices), so null is the careful answer - yet filling in either stated price is defensible.

items.document: Plover Desk Pad, felt, gray. $13.25 each. Shelf shows 0; 60 units in receiving, not yet shelved.
items.rationale: Nothing shelved and sellable now (0) versus units physically on premises (60): 'in stock' can carry either scope.

items.document: Egret Task Chair, mesh back - packaging may say 'Egret Chair Pro' (same product, relabeled this year). $129.00. Stock: 22.
items.rationale: Two live names for one product: the row leads with one, the packaging carries the other, and the record calls them the same product.

items.document: Bittern Floor Mat, ribbed rubber. $33.00 each. Stock ledger: 14; physical count last Friday: 17.
items.rationale: System of record (14) versus observed count (17): the record reports both and does not adjudicate.
